title: Object-Centric Differentiable Logic Networks for Abstract Visual Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.30736v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Human visual intelligence enables efficient reasoning capabilities on abstract visual problems with bounded cognitive resources and minimal experience, and yields remarkable generalization to novel problems with its ability to draw relational analogies and modular abstractions. In contrast, deep learning models require exhaustive task-specific training on large datasets, making them prone to exploiting visual shortcuts and resulting in poor generalization. While neuro-symbolic approaches attempt to bridge this gap by decoupling perception from reasoning with dedicated computation units, existing solutions rely either on explicit rule supervision or parameter-heavy transformer architectures that reintroduce the computational inefficiencies they aim to solve. translated_title: 面向抽象视觉推理的以对象为中心的可微逻辑网络
translated_abstract: 人类视觉智能能够在有限的认知资源和极少经验下，对抽象视觉问题进行高效推理，并凭借其建立关系类比和模块化抽象的能力，对新颖问题展现出出色的泛化能力。相比之下，深度学习模型需要在大型数据集上进行详尽的特定任务训练，使其容易利用视觉捷径，导致泛化能力差。虽然神经符号方法试图通过使用专用计算单元将感知与推理解耦来弥合这一差距，但现有解决方案要么依赖显式规则监督，要么依赖参数繁重的Transformer架构，从而重新引入了它们本想解决的计算低效问题。我们提出Slot-DWN来解决这些局限性，这是一种新颖的神经符号架构，将无监督的对象中心感知与基于逻辑的符号推理统一起来。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Slot-DWN，一种将无监督对象中心感知与基于逻辑的可微符号推理相统一的新型神经符号架构，无需显式规则监督即可高效解决抽象视觉推理任务，同时避免了参数繁重的Transformer架构带来的计算低效问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Slot-DWN, a novel neuro-symbolic architecture that unifies unsupervised object-centric perception with logic-based symbolic reasoning, enabling efficient abstract visual reasoning without explicit rule supervision or computationally heavy transformer architectures.
